policy.goal: Reconcile authoritative sources before book ingestion
policy.duplicate_rule: Same authoritative source or endpoint family is not counted twice merely because it appears in multiple subject batches
policy.book_gate: Do not begin bulk book ingestion until subject coverage, duplicate review, rights policy, and ingestion-path checks pass

audit_checks.description: Inventory root resource catalogs plus legacy resource-batches directory
Normalize source identity and flag repeated authoritative endpoints
Require credible primary/reference coverage for every required subject
Confirm metadata/link/full-text storage policy before books
Verify resources can feed retrieval/ingestion rather than existing only as labels
Book ingestion opens only after prior checks pass

next_action: Finish normalized inventory and fill only genuine subject gaps.
